stories.headline: Search for survivors after 16 killed by Russian double-tap strike on Ukraine mall
stories.description: Nine people are still missing after the attack which left 130 injured, including a number of children.

stories.headline: Iran says new US sanctions violate sovereignty of other states
stories.description: Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei slams Trump’s latest threat as a return to ‘full-scale classic colonialism’.

stories.headline: Somali pirates hijack oil tanker off Yemen as piracy resurges
stories.description: Somali pirates have hijacked an oil tanker off Yemen, marking a resurgence in piracy.

stories.headline: ‘Young want to leave’: Libya’s brain drain, 15 years after Tripoli fell
stories.description: Professionals who left a country in turmoil say they are unlikely to return as more in Libya could be planning to leave.

stories.headline: World Bank projects war-hit Lebanon’s economy to contract by 6.4 percent
stories.description: Conflict with Israel derails Lebanon’s economic recovery as inflation and consumer prices rise, the global lender says.
